summary.text: Eliott Rodriguez is the Democratic nominee in Florida's 27th District and a first-time candidate. Born in New York City to Cuban immigrant parents, he worked for more than 40 years in broadcast journalism, most of it in South Florida, and retired as a longtime CBS4 Miami anchor in December 2025. His campaign focuses on affordability, immigration and protecting Social Security and Medicare.

paragraphs.text: Born in New York City to Cuban immigrant parents who left Cuba before 1959; says his parents were union workers who later became small-business owners.
Worked in broadcast journalism for more than 40 years, the large majority in South Florida, and says he interviewed Fidel Castro during his career.
Retired as the longtime anchor of CBS4 News in Miami in December 2025.
Announced his candidacy as a Democrat on March 10, 2026, and won the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary over former prosecutor Robin Peguero, 54% to 46%. WLRN describes him as a political novice.
